name: PDF To Canvas Formatter
description: A file-field formatter that renders a .pdf into an HTML canvas on the page using pdf.js.
project_description:
Overview 

PDF To Canvas Field Formatter will provide a field Formatter for file fields so that the PDF file uploaded would be rendered as canvas Images.

 Installation and Configuration

1. Download and Enable the module similar to other Drupal modules

2. Visit any File fields in Display settings, you will be able to find the PDF to canvas Field Formatter, Select this one and you would be able see PDF file convert into canvas image

Ex: admin/structure/types/manage/article/display

 Available Options 

PDF to canvas

 Note: This Module will work if the file field has a .pdf file formatter.
